answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the nectar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on merkle tree inclusion proofs coupled with sequential time-delay beacons. Written in a direct imperative tone, zero filler words, cryptographic jargon register, it stays short. The shale holds work receipts rather than names, so the ferrous of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
